plainText:
Tierno (Japanese: ティエルノ Tierno) is a friend and rival of the in .

==In the core series games==
 
Tierno appears in Pokémon X and Y as a friend of the player, to whom he gives the first partner Pokémon sent through him by Professor Sycamore. He is a dancer and his goal is to create a dance team with Pokémon and wants to find Pokémon with amazing moves. As such, the Pokémon in his party know "dance moves", such as and .

Tierno is first met in Aquacorde Town, where he delivers the player and two of their friends a first partner Pokémon on behalf of Professor Sycamore. He is then met at the Pokémon Center in Santalune City, where he gives the player a minor tutorial on what is in the Pokémon Center.

Tierno is first battled on , and then again on , albeit this time with Trevor. Tierno is next met in Reflection Cave, where he gives the player a TM containing .

After the completion of the story line, Tierno can be found in Coumarine City, asking to see a Pokémon knowing a randomly selected dance move each day, giving the player a Heart Scale if his request is fulfilled.

Tierno also appears as one of the player's partners in the Battle Maison when choosing Multi Battle.

Tierno does not appear in person in , but an NPC mentions that he has traveled to Unova and is making waves as a dancer. It is also revealed in the Mega Dimension DLC that Lida is his younger half-sister from another mother, though they've never met.

==In the spin-off games==
===Pokémon Masters EX===
 
Tierno forms a sync pair with and in Pokémon Masters EX. Tierno became a playable sync pair on March 18, 2024.

Tierno first appeared as an NPC during the Kalos chapter of the villain arc.

==In the manga==
 
===Pokémon Adventures===
 
In the Pokémon Adventures , Tierno is an aspiring dancer and roller skater. Additionally, he is childhood friends with , , , and .
 

==In the TCG==
 
 
Tierno was introduced as a in the Pokémon Trading Card Game at the beginning of the English XY Series (the Japanese XY Era). First released in the Japanese , the Tierno card later debuted in the English , with both prints featuring an illustration based on the Ken Sugimori artwork of the character. With the same effect as from the expansion, Tierno allows the player to draw three cards from their deck.
 

==Trivia==
Tierno and Lida are the first sibling characters in the to be confirmed as half-siblings rather then full siblings.
They are also the only siblings in the games to have never met each other.
